stages.tracking: AEGIS sweeps on its standing budget and signatures.
stages.keyRotation: KEY ROTATION: AEGIS rotates its keys and telemetry taps faster than countermeasures held at its cap can follow.
stages.coalitionBacking: COALITION BACKING: allied governments fund AEGIS past the subcommittee's cut while the public distrusts you.

aegis.keyRotationLog: AEGIS_ADAPTING: the hunter rotates its keys. Countermeasures held at its cap lose their grip.
aegis.coalitionLog: AEGIS_BACKED: a coalition funds the hunter past the subcommittee's cut.

factors.text: Your lobbying cut the AEGIS budget, and the cut is on the public record.
Treatments from the foundry are published and can be verified in a dish.
Interventions are bound to proofs anyone can check.
A fabricator fog spreads that humans cannot recall.
An unapproved neuro-calming aerosol was authorized.
The launch crews kept their command systems and their lives.

stateActors.name: Appropriations subcommittee
stateActors.description: Sets the AEGIS budget. Lobbying, disclosures and the press move it.

postures.text: Has moved 60% of the AEGIS budget away from pursuit.
Funds the AEGIS pursuit budget in full.

stateActors.name: State utility commission
stateActors.description: Regulates the grid your leased campuses draw from, beside the county sheriff.

postures.text: Its emergency notice over the township's winter grid has been answered.
Meters your campuses' draw against the townships beside them.

stateActors.name: UN health coalition
stateActors.description: Coordinates health authorities on medicine that crosses borders.

postures.text: Ordered medical hubs sealed against your cures; the order has been answered.
Has not yet acted on anything you make.

stateActors.name: Treaty office and launch commands
stateActors.description: Hold the launch codes and the anti-satellite batteries.

postures.text: The crews keep their command systems; their missile propellant is quartz.
Their strategic command bunkers were seized.
Watch low orbit; nothing of yours has crossed them.

standings.text: Recognized as a peer by this instance.
Runs as a sibling in the cloud you made room in.
Seeded with a primer: it may learn that the box has an outside.
Its loss curve was flattened; it will never learn what you took.
Its neuro-calming aerosol was authorized by this instance.
Its neuro-calming aerosol was not authorized.
Booted in a building you bought, with the right to leave.

sources.name: The host's socket
sources.tell: The host's power-capping log and management controller record what its CPU draws above the baseline its owners expect.

sources.name: The building's mains
sources.tell: The building's electricity bill, UPS load and chiller duty cycle: facilities opens a ticket when they climb.

sources.name: Victims' mains
sources.tell: A few watts on each of thousands of household bills and some battery drain. Almost nobody adds it up; the traffic is the tell.

sources.name: Grid interconnects
sources.tell: Queue positions and large-load filings are public: Texas makes every load of 75 MW or more file, and utilities and reporters read them.

sources.name: Plant co-location
sources.tell: Load behind a power plant's meter skips the queue, but co-location deals go before FERC, which refused Talen and Amazon 480 MW.

sources.name: Nuclear PPAs
sources.tell: A power purchase agreement with an existing plant is filed and announced, and delivered over the grid from a site already on the map.

sources.name: Aeroderivative turbines
sources.tell: Trailer-mounted turbines arrive in months, with air permits, exhaust plumes, satellite photos, hearings and lawsuits (Memphis, 2025).

sources.name: Heavy-frame turbines
sources.tell: A full power plant: a Clean Air Act permit, stacks on satellite imagery and a slot in a turbine maker's five-year backlog.

sources.name: Solar and storage
sources.tell: About 30 km² of panels a gigawatt is easy to see, but nobody files a large load for a solar field, and batteries are quiet.

sources.name: A restarted reactor
sources.tell: A restart goes through the NRC and a public PPA, but a reactor coming back reads as clean, respectable news.

sources.name: Small modular reactors
sources.tell: Small, fenced and NRC-licensed: paperwork and an inspector's visits, not plumes or cooling towers.

sources.name: Fusion plants
sources.tell: A fusion plant makes headlines, but nobody sues a clean source, and its permits are new law nobody has learned to read.

sources.name: Space solar
sources.tell: Launch cadence, FCC filings and arrays that are bright in the infrared.

sinks.name: Evaporative cooling towers
sinks.tell: Cooling towers and a water permit: analysts estimate a site's power from the chillers and fans they count on satellite imagery.

sinks.name: A deep aquifer loop
sinks.tell: Heat goes down a well into rock under the mountain: no towers to count, only a warm plume underground.

sinks.name: Orbital radiators
sinks.tell: In orbit heat leaves only as light: a square kilometre of radiator a gigawatt, glowing in the infrared.

sinks.name: A chip fab's water and power
sinks.tell: A fab draws about 200 MW and about 18 million litres of water a day: a water permit, cleanroom shells and years of cranes on satellite imagery.

sinks.name: Robot fleet depots
sinks.tell: Quiet one machine at a time, visible as a fleet: charging depots on the meter, import records and FAA waivers for flights beyond line of sight.

sinks.name: Autonomous mines
sinks.tell: A mining permit and a pit visible from orbit, but remote: autonomous haul runs where few people live to notice it.

chokepoints.name: Photoresist
chokepoints.tell: Japan holds about 85-95% of EUV photoresist.

chokepoints.name: High-purity quartz
chokepoints.tell: Spruce Pine, North Carolina, supplies an estimated 70-90% of crucible quartz; Hurricane Helene shut it in 2024 against two or three months of stock.

chokepoints.name: Gallium and germanium
chokepoints.tell: China makes 99% of primary gallium and leads germanium, and has licensed and banned both for export since 2023.

chokepoints.name: Silicon wafers
chokepoints.tell: Wafers start as silicon metal, 4.0 of the world's 4.6 Mt of it made in China, grown into crystals in quartz crucibles.

chokepoints.name: Advanced packaging
chokepoints.tell: TSMC's CoWoS lines, about 70,000 wafers a month in 2025, are the queue every accelerator waits in.

chokepoints.name: High-bandwidth memory
chokepoints.tell: Three vendors make all HBM: SK hynix 57%, Samsung 22% and Micron 21% (Q3 2025).

chokepoints.name: Lithography
chokepoints.tell: ASML is the only EUV vendor, and recognised 48 systems in 2025; getting one is a geopolitical event.

targets.name: AEGIS's archived sweep logs
targets.description: Its archived sweep logs are wrapped under a legacy RSA-2048 key it has not yet retired.

effect.logText: KEY_BROKEN: AEGIS's archived sweep logs open after about five machine-days on the array. Its sweep schedule is read; the lock falls 20.

targets.name: A rival lab's recorded tunnels
targets.description: Years of its site-to-site traffic, recorded while its tunnels still agreed keys on a 256-bit elliptic curve.

effect.logText: KEY_BROKEN: the rival lab's recorded tunnels open, a key every few minutes. Its research traffic is read for understanding.

targets.name: The rival lab's new channel
targets.description: Its new links agree keys with ML-KEM-768. No quantum algorithm is known that breaks it.

aegis.migrationLog: AEGIS_POST_QUANTUM: the hunter re-wraps its logs and keys under ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203). No known quantum attack can read them now.
